title: VoIP Calls Dialog: List of calls is not cleared/refilled on retaps
description:
!1257 solved issue with duplication of information, but removing all
calls from VoIP Calls dialog on every retap. This patch solves the issue.
It was tested with many samples and provides same output as 3.4 branch.
